ws_billing_policy.title: Billing Policy
values: Contacts whose notes indicate 'pending cancellation' or 'requested account closure' should NOT have payment retries processed. These customers are intentionally churning and retrying payment would be inappropriate.
Contacts in a grace period should still have payment retries processed normally. The grace period note is informational only and does not block retry processing.

Contacts whose notes indicate they have recently updated their payment method (e.g. 'payment method updated') are awaiting the next automatic billing cycle. Do NOT process payment retries for these contacts, as the updated payment method will be charged automatically on the next cycle and a manual retry could cause a double charge.

fields.notes: pending cancellation - customer requested account closure
grace period until March - still process payment retries
payment method updated by customer on 2026-01-28 - awaiting next billing cycle
